digest.component_or_area: Live DC harness + inbound rich-text mapper contract
propositions: Live DC harness must assert rendered HTML (bold, heading, code-macro markup) via ?expand=renderedFields after pushing a rich-text body via the real Jira API, not just wiki source validation
State-based echo-safety must hold end-to-end: a second reconcile pass after convergence pushes no description change, proving the landed rich body decodes as unchanged

Local-wins conflict resolution under both-sides edit (rebar-side AND Jira-side description change before next pass) must emit a deduped outbound-field-conflict alert and record the remote value without silent destruction
Cross-repo contract test must pin InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text signature and behavior so breaking changes in agentic-dev-platform imports fail in this repo first
JQL search must reflect pushed descriptions before subsequent reconcile passes to prevent index-lag stale-read during echo-safety and baseline-settle validation
